shots.focal_element: Simplified white blog-page mockup with the headline and a hero photo of a person wearing headphones
shots.typography: Clean geometric sans; small regular-weight nav label, bold sentence-case article headline; dark text on white; skeleton grey bars stand in for body copy
shots.what_happens: The previous shot's area-chart card and green trophy slide off to the right with heavy motion blur and a ghosted trail, revealing the blog-page mockup underneath, which settles centered on the green-to-yellow gradient while the VO finishes 'to Google' (w174).
shots.build_rebuild: Stack the outgoing chart card above a static centered blog mockup, then tween the card x:+60% with a directional motion blur and opacity to 0 over ~0.4 s (ease-in) so the blog page is revealed beneath it.

shots.focal_element: Browser-window card titled 'AI Search Performance' with two stacked-bar chart panels, later overlaid by ChatGPT and Perplexity app icons
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans, sentence/title case, tight tracking for the window title (types on character by character with a lime-green leading character); medium-weight panel titles; tiny regular legend and axis labels; small pill buttons
shots.what_happens: The blog page blurs out behind a horizontal blur band while a browser-chrome window drops in; its title types on, the Brand Mention panel appears and its stacked bars grow up from the baseline, then a second Website Citation panel joins and its bars grow; ChatGPT then Perplexity app icons pop onto the charts as the VO names 'ChatGPT and Perplexity' (w185-w188).
shots.build_rebuild: Fade-and-unblur a window card in, typewriter its title, reveal panel 1 and scale its stacked bars from scaleY 0 with a 0.1 s stagger, repeat for panel 2, then pop two app-icon tiles (scale 0.6 to 1 with slight overshoot and drop shadow) on the VO cue words.

shots.composition_other: Three overlapping cards in a loose staggered collage (top-left, top-right, front-bottom-center)
shots.focal_element: Collage of three cards: AI Market Share donut chart, Page Experience 50/100 score, and Your Topic Performance table
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans card titles in sentence/title case; large light-weight numeric score '50/100' with a matching small 'Moderate' label in an amber accent; small regular legend items with coloured bullets; white-on-black pill table headers
shots.what_happens: The AI Search Performance window is pushed up and out with motion blur as three cards fly up from below with blur and settle into an overlapping collage; the cards drift slightly apart while the VO says 'discover how to win' (w193-w197).
shots.build_rebuild: Translate the outgoing window y:-100% with motion blur while three absolutely-positioned cards enter from y:+80% with blur 12px to 0 and a ~0.1 s stagger, then drift each a few px outward over the rest of the shot.

shots.focal_element: The real Conductor 'Pages' analytics dashboard with AI vs organic charts, AI-engine breakdown, organic performance, YoY, citations, indexability and schema panels
shots.typography: Product UI sans (dashboard font), small bold panel titles in title case, dense small regular metric labels and bold metric numbers; only panel titles quoted, smaller metric/legend text not transcribed
shots.what_happens: The card collage pushes up and away as a full dashboard window rises from the bottom; the camera slowly pushes in, then scrolls down the page through Organic Performance, Year Over Year Performance and AI Prompts with Citations to Page Indexability and Schema.org Usage, with a final zoom-in on the lower charts, as the VO lists brand mentions, citations, sentiment, referral traffic, analytics, technical signals and business goals (w198-w232).
shots.build_rebuild: Place a tall dashboard screenshot inside a dark device frame on the gradient, slide it up from below, then animate a slow scale 1 to 1.15 and a translateY scroll down the page over ~12 s with ease-in-out, ending on a slight push-in to the bottom panels.

shots.focal_element: Centered white headline 'All in one place' on the soft blue-green-yellow gradient
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans, sentence case, large display size, normal tracking, white with a faint shadow
shots.what_happens: The dashboard leaves and the line 'All in one place' resolves letter by letter out of blur on the empty gradient, synced to the VO 'all in one place' (w233-w236), then holds.
shots.build_rebuild: Split the headline into characters and tween each from blur(10px) opacity 0 to blur(0) opacity 1 in a randomised stagger over ~0.5 s, starting on the first spoken word, then hold.
